name: anycubic-slicer-next-control
description: Secure local control of Anycubic Slicer Next on Windows through structured MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Safely prepare, export, and LAN-print local slicing jobs.
interface.longDescription: Opens Anycubic Slicer Next, loads STL or 3MF models, applies validated basic settings, slices locally, exports G-code or G-code 3MF artifacts, inspects the desktop UI, and can upload/start/control prints on a LAN Anycubic printer over MQTT/FTP.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my Anycubic Slicer Next installation.
Prepare a safe slicing plan for this STL.
Discover my Anycubic printer and report its status.
Upload and start a print on my Anycubic printer.
